name: Genève Aéroport

hours.v: open at all times, subject to the night-flight rules
hours.quote: L’aéroport est ouvert en permanence sous réserve des prescriptions applicables aux vols de nuit.

curfew.v: non-commercial take-offs and landings banned 22:00-06:00. Planned flights allowed until midnight, plus half an hour for delayed flights; no aircraft before 06:00. Any planned commercial movement 22:00-06:00 also needs the airport operator's prior approval (through slot coordination or case by case)
curfew.quote: Les décollages et les atterrissages de vols non commerciaux sont interdits entre 22 heures et 6 heures. ... Les vols planifiés sont autorisés jusqu’à 23 heures à l’aéroport national de Zurich et jusqu’à minuit à celui de Genève. ... Il faut ajouter une demi-heure à ces horaires pour les vols retardés. ... Cependant, aucun avion ne peut décoller d’un aéroport national ou y atterrir avant 6 heures.
curfew.also_quote: tout mouvement commercial planifié entre 22 h et 6 h

noise.v: noise quotas apply to the night period 22:00-05:59; for business and general aviation they cover take-offs after 22:00 by aircraft in noise classes IV and V
noise.quote: The available NOISE QUOTAS are determined globally for the night period (10:00 p.m. – 5:59 a.m. LT).

ppr.v: prior permission (PPR) needed for business and general aviation; bookings open 5 days ahead, made through the handling agent
ppr.quote: prior permission (PPR) is required for operations not regulated by Slot Coordination Switzerland.

slots.v: PPR slot booking opens 5 days before the flight; the PPR number goes in item 18 of the flight plan

handling.v: the airport's private aviation contacts list includes TAG Aviation, Jet Aviation, Global Jet, Sparfell and others; separate partner pages for Signature Flight Support, Swissport Executive Aviation and Dassault Aviation Business Services; the airport's PPR page says a handling agent is mandatory for commercial flights and in all cases on the south apron; non-commercial self-handling only on the north of the platform

runway.v: one paved runway, 3,900 m long, and a grass runway of about 820 m, 250 m apart (FOCA-published study of 17 Jun 2014; width not stated; the FOCA SIL sheet of 14 Nov 2018 says the grass runway will be removed). Re-check the length against the current AIP
runway.quote: L'aéroport de Genève dispose d'une piste en dur (3'900m) et d'une piste en herbe (~820 m)

notes: Swiss eAIP is a paid product on skybriefing.com and was not read; the federal OSIA text on fedlex could not be opened. The 22:00-06:00 window is the period in which planned commercial movements need prior approval (operating regulations, état 8 Jan 2018 / 1 Jan 2025 versions), not a stated total closure; do not call it a curfew. The handler list is the airport's 'private aviation contacts' list and includes brokers (e.g. LunaJets) that are not handlers; the page also has a 'Show more' button so the list may be incomplete. Partner pages also exist for Signature Flight Support, Swissport Executive Aviation Geneva and Dassault Aviation Business Services (not opened). Slot Coordination Switzerland: GA/BA cannot request airport slots from it at Geneva; all GA/BA flights need mandatory airport movement permission (PPR) via the handling agent (already in the existing file).
